notes: KNOWN BUG (weaker than printed), fails today. Teferi, Timeless Voyager [-8], second sentence: 'Until the end of your next turn, they can't phase in.' The Ogre must skip its controller's next untap step. The compiler's built-in _phase_in_prevention_effect emits PREVENT_EFFECT over ZoneChangeEvent(COMMAND -> BATTLEFIELD); phasing is a status, not a zone change (CR 702.26d), so no consumer can match it and the Ogre phases back in. Needs a phase-in event in the ontology (next gated round); see docs/BACKLOG.md.
